name: js-pointing-bubble-monorepo
description: Monorepo for js-pointing-bubble, vue-pointing-bubble, and react-pointing-bubble.

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter js-pointing-bubble --filter vue-pointing-bubble --filter react-pointing-bubble run build
scripts.build:playground: pnpm registry:build && pnpm --filter @js-pointing-bubble/playground-vue build && pnpm --filter @js-pointing-bubble/playground-react build && node scripts/assemble-pages.mjs
scripts.registry:build: pnpm registry:merge && pnpm exec shadcn-vue build registry/vue/registry.json -o demo/playground-vue/public/r
scripts.test: pnpm --filter js-pointing-bubble test && pnpm --filter vue-pointing-bubble test && pnpm --filter react-pointing-bubble test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter js-pointing-bubble typecheck && pnpm --filter vue-pointing-bubble typecheck && pnpm --filter react-pointing-bubble typecheck
